description: Implementation of an in-memory, thread-safe note repository using ConcurrentDictionary, supporting CRUD operations for Note objects, intended for use within a notes backend application.

classes.name: InMemoryNoteRepository
classes.description: A thread-safe, in-memory implementation of INoteRepository utilizing ConcurrentDictionary to manage Note objects, providing asynchronous CRUD operations.

methods.name: ListAsync
methods.description: Returns a task that provides a read-only collection of all notes, ordered by most recently updated.

methods.name: GetAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its GUID identifier asynchronously; returns null if not found.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new note with the given title and content, assigns a new GUID, sets creation and update timestamps, and stores it in the dictionary.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by GUID with new title and content, maintaining the created timestamp, and updates the timestamp.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Removes a note by its GUID identifier from the store asynchronously, returning true if successful.

methods.name: Seed
methods.description: Seeds the in-memory store with a specified number of sample notes for development purposes.
